final: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), timing_groups AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm) SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS mean_group_average, AVG(group_avg - overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM timing_groups CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE group_avg > overall_avg
